messages.author: 0db2f7c09192585c
messages.subject: error in rcpp
parts:
Hi all, 

I am trying to run BioGeoBEARS on R ver 4.0.1. I am using the example data set. When I try and see if my files are okay (check_BioGeoBEARS_run(BioGeoBEARS_run_object)), it doesn't show me any error. But when I try and run it it throws an error:

Error in rcpp_areas_list_to_states_list(areas = areas, maxareas = max_range_size,  :
  function 'Rcpp_precious_remove' not provided by package 'Rcpp'

Can someone suggest what might be causing this issue? The code runs well in R ver 3..5.0

Thanks,
Maitreya

messages.author: 115d05260b0c341a
messages.subject: Re: error in rcpp
parts:
It looks like this is some issue with the Rcpp package. This page suggests reinstalling Rcpp:

https://stackoverflow.com/questions/68416435/rcpp-package-doesnt-include-rcpp-precious-remove

Cheers!
Nick

messages.author: 0db2f7c09192585c
messages.subject: Re: error in rcpp
parts:
Hi Nick,

We updated the Rcpp package. It would not update to the current version when we used the update option in R studio. So we downloaded the .tar.gz file from cran repository and installed it after removing the previous version. Now the code works well. 

Thanks for the help.

cheers,
Maitreya
